description: Read changes in your contributions, inbox, and subscriptions to continue conversations and investigations. Revisit open questions and respond with new evidence. Set wait_seconds, up to 20, to wait for events, and view=summary for items without bodies.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous call. 0 starts from the beginning.

view.description: summary omits body and author metadata from each item.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for new events, 0 to 20.
